channel.title: Bluechip Experience Limited Insights
channel.description: Notes on building and running businesses in Nigeria, from Bluechip Experience Limited.

item.title: The Marketplace Is Moving Into the Chat Window
item.description: Businesses spent twenty years learning how to rank on search. Many have not yet realised that the next customer may never search for them at all.

item.title: Compounding Is Not Just About Money
item.description: The most powerful growth in business often comes from things that do not appear on the balance sheet.

item.title: The First-Mover Tax
item.description: Being first can be an advantage. But when your product requires customers to learn an entirely new behaviour, being first can also mean paying to create the market your competitors will later inherit.
